world:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: environment key art for The Last Throne, a stylized Roblox cooperative fantasy action RPG.
Create a polished wide landscape concept illustration, approximately 16:9, of GLOAMWOOD, an ominous forest whose paths and ancient watchfort have become a giant spider hunting ground. Dense ancient blue-black and deep green trees form a closed canopy. Thick silver-white silk connects tree trunks high above the ground; a broken wooden supply cart hangs in silk between branches, not on the ground. A few fully wrapped, non-graphic rescue cocoons hang near a ruined woodland watchfort, no visible injury or exposed bodies. The clear winding traversable path remains readable in pale moonlight, with low fog confined near roots. A small warm amber survivor shelter occupies a safe clearing to the left, with two tiny blocky traveler silhouettes for scale; no combat companion party. In the distance, roots pierce the stone watchfort, and a partial silhouette of an enormous purple armored spider is barely visible inside its huge arched entrance. The forest is the main subject, not a dungeon interior.
Style: premium stylized 3D fantasy game concept, chunky sculpted tree forms and angular stonework, clean faceted materials and crisp readable silhouettes, dramatic but not photoreal horror. Spider identity: glossy black-purple segmented exoskeleton, long angular legs, subtle violet glow, no humanoid torso.
Palette: midnight blue/deep forest green, silver silk, limited violet enemy accents, warm amber safety area. Moonlight and reflected ground light must reveal the actual walkable floor. Strong foreground/midground/background depth and compelling sense of exploration.
Only text: small elegant title "GLOAMWOOD" and subtitle "THE SILKEN DARK", both exact English and unobtrusive. No epic number, UI, stats, map markers, watermarks, portals, giant magic crystals, gore, dismemberment, modern equipment, zombie graveyard, or nearly black unreadable areas. This is a new forest candidate, not a visual remake of old epics 5-8.
normals_blocky_v3:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept production redesign.
Reference: the seven-creature Gloamwood board. Create a NEW SIX-NORMAL-ENEMY modeling concept board. Preserve each existing creature's recognizable FACE identity as closely as possible (eye placement/color, ears, mouth/fangs, expression and forehead shapes). Redesign ONLY bodies and limbs toward VERY BLOCKY LOW-POLY ROBLOX MODELING. This should visibly look like simple game meshes that could be built with cuboids, wedges and a small number of chamfered boxes. Design target is 2,000-3,000 triangles PER COMPLETE CREATURE, including head/body/limbs; this is an intended modeling target, not a measured claim. Do not add triangle-count text or fake wireframes.
EXACTLY SIX panels in a 3-column x 2-row layout, one full-body three-quarter specimen per panel, no cropped wings/feet, no overlap, clear neutral blue-gray studio background and soft grounded shadows. Top row: WEBLING, SILKWEAVER, BARKSTALKER. Bottom row: GLOAMBAT, HOLLOWBARK ENT, VENOMCOIL CENTIPEDE. Only exact English header "GLOAMWOOD - NORMAL ENEMIES" and those six names below each panel. No queen on this normal sheet, no other monsters.
WEBLING: preserve the cute-menacing dark face with two large violet eyes and pale short fangs. Replace rounded abdomen with a chunky chamfered PURPLE BOX and blocky small head. Exactly eight simple legs, each built from only two rectangular prism segments ending in a wedge. NO smooth sphere abdomen.
SILKWEAVER: preserve slender silver-indigo spider face, violet eyes and long fangs. Long angular rectangular/wedge abdomen, eight thin but visibly rectangular bar legs, only two segments per leg, very little secondary trim. No complex spun web geometry, one simple silk line optional.
BARKSTALKER: preserve the yellow-green-eyed bark spider face and short fangs. Broad squat BOX carapace with only 3-5 large bark slab shapes, eight short rectangular angled legs, moss suggested by a few large flat green polygons. No dozens of leaf clumps, tiny bark shards or high-frequency surface detail.
GLOAMBAT: keep the same bat's pointed ears, purple eyes, muzzle and small visible fangs. Compact cuboid torso, a few large flat triangular tufts instead of detailed fur. Two wide wings made of a few large flat polygon membrane panels and thick simple angular finger bars, simple block claw feet. Clearly a BAT, not a moth or dragon. Entire wing outline visible.
HOLLOWBARK ENT: keep existing amber eyes and the bark face's stern mouth silhouette. One thick rectangular tree trunk body, two upper/lower arms built from LARGE BOX segments, broad blocky root feet. Branch crown limited to 3-4 large angular branches with 2-3 flat leaf clusters. Bark grooves largely painted onto broad faces. NO tangled fine roots or many thin branches.
VENOMCOIL CENTIPEDE: preserve violet multiple eyes, paired curved pale mandibles and antenna silhouette from the reference. Body uses ONLY 10-12 repeated chamfered rectangular blocks in a shallow S-curve, each with one pair of simple low-detail two-piece rectangular legs. Long and low, many legs but readable modular construction. Only a few large dorsal wedges, NO dozens of small spikes, no smooth detailed organic plating.
Style: deliberate block-built low-poly production concepts, very broad clean flat planes and visibly squared limbs, faces retained with texture-like surface details where possible. Restrained faceting, not merely faceted high-poly organic sculpt. Same midnight/slate palette and violet/amber face colors as reference, simple material shading. No film-quality organic rendering, fine fur, realistic wood texture, decorative filigree, tiny spikes, glow fog hiding shapes, UI, portals, stats, terrain or weapon props. No Gloomwing Moth, no Broodguard. Exact topology/counts will be determined later in actual models.
bosses_blocky_v3_initial:

Faces must retain as closely as possible each parent's eye layout/color, expression and mouth/fangs. The queen especially retains the broad purple skull-face plate, dark menacing eye shapes, big violet fangs and dripping purple venom identity of image 2. Rebuild bodies and ALL limbs as LARGE BLOCKY CUBOIDS, CHAMFERED BOXES AND WEDGES for a Roblox game, aiming for ONLY 2,000-3,000 triangles PER COMPLETE BOSS. Boss power comes from proportions/size and a few LARGE shapes, not thousands of spikes or surface details. Do not print measured triangle counts or wireframes.
Wide landscape sheet with EXACTLY THREE equal panels in one row, each contains ONE unclipped full-body three-quarter boss, large clear silhouettes, generous margins, no minions/terrain/other creatures. Neutral dark slate-blue backgrounds, simple neutral studio lighting that reveals front/side planes, thin elegant panel lines. Heading exact "GLOAMWOOD - BOSSES". Gold "BOSS" small above each panel, with these EXACT names below: "THE WIDOW QUEEN", "ANCIENT HOLLOWBARK", "VENOMCOIL MATRIARCH".
Left THE WIDOW QUEEN: queen-like massively enlarged high-backed CHAMFERED BOX abdomen with only 3 broad stepped shell plates, broad skull forehead shape and fearsome purple fangs faithful to input2. Eight thick rectangular bar legs, only 2-3 chunky segments per leg, wedge blade ends. A few large shoulder/carpath wedges and heavier front pair make her visibly a boss compared to the normal small spiders. No human torso, literal crown, humanoid body, extra legs or complex ornate armor. Purple/black glossy broad faces, face marking looks like a painted/emissive texture instead of tiny carved mesh details.
Middle ANCIENT HOLLOWBARK: BOSS ENT distinct from the normal ent, retaining its amber eyes and bark mouth identity. Only 4-5 large broken branch prongs form an ancient canopy silhouette with a few flat dark green leaf patches. Face set high between shoulder blocks. Right VENOMCOIL MATRIARCH: BOSS CENTIPEDE with same multiple violet eyes, antennae and large paired mandibles as normal centipede. Long thick body built from ONLY 10-12 big repeated BOX segments in a broad C-shaped curve so whole length is visible. Head and first two segments especially broad like a blocky armored shield, large two simple tusk-like mandibles, angular burgundy-purple carapace with copper-red edge colors. One pair of thick simple rectangular two-piece legs per body segment, only 3-4 large dorsal wedge spines total. Heavy low armored crawler, NOT a spider abdomen, worm, dragon, insect queen with wings or extra face.
Strong modeling-readability: flat front/top/side planes, hard blocky joints, simplified modular repetitions, no high-detail sculptural bodies. Preserve faces while visibly simplifying torsos and limbs. No photorealism, fine bark/chitin texture, micro-spikes, fur, complex foliage, gradients concealing geometry, battle VFX, environment, epic number, UI/health bars, minions or gore. This is visual modeling guidance, not a completed mesh or verified polygon count.
bosses_blocky_v3_refinement:

Preserve every FACE as closely as possible. LEFT QUEEN: keep her face, skull marking, purple eyes, fangs. Replace her round spherical abdomen with ONE HUGE HIGH-BACKED CHAMFERED RECTANGULAR BOX, with just 2 broad stepped flat plates on top. No rounded dome, no dozens of crystalline facets. Eight legs with exactly TWO thick straight rectangular bars each and a short wedge foot, large squared knees. Remove overlapping leg ornament shards. Keep the final rendering attractive and consistent, but make the BLOCKS and extremely simple modular construction unmistakable at first glance.
